title: Agreement of counter loops
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a state type with decidable equality, and let $M$ be a deterministic $k$-work-tape machine over the Boolean alphabet with states in $S$. For any $a\in S$ and optional exit state, the machine obtained by running the counter loop over the Boolean alphabet and the machine obtained by running it through the identity embedding of the Boolean alphabet into itself have identical transition actions at every state, input symbol, and tuple of work-tape symbols.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a $k$-work-tape machine over Booleans with states in $S$
the exit is an optional state in $S$
